title: Expro wins Global OWI Award for well decommissioning innovation
summary: Industry recognition highlights Expro's leadership in complex well decommissioning projects
body_markdown:
Expro has won the Best Example of Plug and Abandonment Innovation (P&A) award at the 2026 Global Offshore Well Intervention (OWI) Awards, highlighting the company’s expertise in delivering innovative solutions that support the safe, efficient and responsible retirement of offshore wells.


During the 155-well decommissioning campaign, Expro worked with the operator to refine how wells were plugged and abandoned as work progressed, utilising the deployment of technologies including CX-Ball, Drop Drift Cleaner (DDC), CX-SV Squeeze Packer and the Gator Perforator, an explosive-free perforating tool from technology partner Lee Energy Systems. The innovations reduced rig time, lowered personnel exposure and improved operational flexibility throughout the project.


Expro entered the awards as a finalist in the following categories:


-


Best Example of P&A Innovation


-


Best Example of Subsea Intervention


-


Best Example of Platform Intervention


-


Best Example of Well Integrity Innovation


-


Best example of Sustainable Well Intervention


Carole Paley, UK Managing Director at Expro, said: “This award recognises what our teams achieved by combining technical innovation with operational experience. Working closely with our client gave us the opportunity to apply what we learnt on one well to the next, while adapting our approach to the conditions on each well.


“Our focus on every project is to deliver safer, more efficient and more predictable outcomes. On a campaign of this scale, we had the opportunity to embed new technologies and continuously improve performance. We are extremely proud that this work has been recognised by the industry."


The OWI Awards recognise excellence and innovation across the well intervention sector. Expro's success reinforces its position as a trusted partner for operators seeking to safely and efficiently manage mature assets and end-of-life field operations, while supporting broader industry objectives around cost efficiency, environmental responsibility and the energy transition.
